integrity.proof_scope: Symbolic all-parameter integral argument, with explicit Mayer--Vietoris injection and Alexander duality.
integrity.verification: Independent finite simplicial reconstruction and signed boundary ranks modulo two primes; recorded stdout embedded.

scientific_limitations: Both bipartition shores have at least three vertices and precisely one cross-edge is absent.
The original cut complex has an integral homology classification; only the Alexander dual has a proven wedge-of-spheres homotopy decomposition.
Finite computations check six parameter pairs but do not independently certify the universal integral theorem.
Coverage of differently named or unindexed prior results is not guaranteed.
title: A missing bipartite edge creates a circle in the Alexander dual of a three-cut complex
